acquisition_gate: Before opening any payload, freeze exact URL, byte count, SHA256, schema, object intersection, masks, covariance, cosmology, PSF, line-spread function, and missing-data action.
primary_rejection_rules: reject empirical universality if a shared closure requires an object-specific photon or lens multiplier
reject a metric closure if deflection and Shapiro/time-delay require inconsistent Phi+Psi normalizations
reject a chromatic closure if its frozen nu^-2 differential is absent after plasma and dust controls
reject a causal-memory closure if the registered lag or hysteresis does not transfer between whole objects
quarantine rather than erase any empirically interesting closure that later fails covariance, conservation, causality, or health

stage_1.frozen_test: Reproduce the registered joint model and report g_lens/g_dyn and reconstructed slip without adding a photon multiplier; use the same stellar mass, anisotropy, distance, external-convergence, and line-of-sight nuisance contract for every closure.

stage_2.frozen_statistic: whole-galaxy held-out joint likelihood and signed residuals in Einstein radius and aperture velocity dispersion, with one shared stellar-population nuisance hierarchy
stage_2.published_sample: 131 candidates, 70 definite lenses, 63 fitted lens models; use only catalog rows whose required lensing, photometry, redshift, and SDSS dispersion fields pass schema
stage_2.split_rule: Sort canonical SLACS name; SHA256(name) mod 5 equals 4 is untouched confirmation; all object-specific constants and photon coefficients are forbidden.

stage_3.frozen_test: Using a closure admitted by stages 1 and 2, predict image time-delay ratios from the already fixed Phi+Psi field; do not fit a new Fermat or photon coefficient.

stage_4.frozen_test: Forward predict image positions, parities, shapes, weak shear, magnification, and any registered time delays from calibrated baryonic light and gas through the unchanged same-law closure.
